design.between_species_confounding: species baseline binary-trait frequency changes logistically with geographic species centre in every world
design.within_species_signal: effect_size multiplies standardized local coordinate in the species-level logit
design.observation_imbalance: per-species target observations increase linearly from base_obs to base_obs * imbalance_ratio across species centres
design.missingness: MCAR deletion within species after trait generation; at least 8 observations forced to remain

interpretation.supported: Across this targeted surface, species-conditioning controls false positives under strong between-species geographic turnover and shows increasing detection as the imposed within-species effect strengthens; random observation loss reduces power mainly at intermediate effects.
not_supported: universal calibration under all spatial sampling processes
superiority over every alternative spatial model
empirical generalization beyond synthetic binary traits
